plainTranslation: The Moon person's emotional rhythm and the Sun person's self-expression tend to cooperate naturally. This can feel familiar and calming, the kind of contact that makes harsher aspects easier to handle. Keep it active so comfort does not turn into autopilot.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryShort: Their moods, needs, and habits of comfort work smoothly with your sense of self, confidence, and direction.
summaryDeep: Their moods, needs, and habits of comfort work smoothly with your sense of self, confidence, and direction. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: The problem is that easy can become lazy. Because the connection feels natural, both people may assume it will just keep going without much care.
advice: Don't sleep on the good thing just because it isn't causing problems. Keep showing up for it.
